title: 乡村交易冲突短剧
visual: specific seasonal agriculture, tactile produce handling, clear village geography, stable vehicles and containers, and visible weather progression
performance: price disagreement, persuasive public speech, divided witnesses, hesitation before an irreversible choice, consequence-driven anger, evidence reveal, and action that continues after the confrontation
camera: establish the market space, alternate speaker and listener coverage, use price/produce/weather inserts as evidence, track the crowd's decision, then reveal the consequence and accountability
audio: distinct village ambience, produce handling, vehicle movement, crowd overlap kept below the active speaker, restrained tension build, storm escalation, and a clean sound bridge across motivated cuts
story_structure: price trigger -> higher bid -> wrong choice -> risk becomes visible -> transaction collapses -> evidence reveal -> group accountability -> continuing-action hook
asset_state: Track vehicle color, crate count, produce condition, cash/deposit status, sky state, rain intensity, and each character's side of the negotiation across adjacent shots.
avoid: generic shouting, unexplained price changes, crowd teleportation, changing vehicles or produce condition, weather arriving without a visible cause, instant moral resolution, and a final pose after the reveal
